Which of the following statements is false?
Option A: Ammonia is produced in repeated high intensity exercise.
Option B: Muscle lactate accumulation does not begin until at least 5 seconds of intermittent muscle contractions have taken place.
Option C: Muscle phosphocreatine depletion begins in the first few seconds of high intensity exercise.
Option D: With an increasing number of repeated sprints the rate of accumulation of lactate in muscle declines.
